package ship

// Calibration fixture for the transport residual scan. Each function is one
// written-down answer; the test's fixture registry declares cleanPost
// (Screened), lateScreen (Screened), readOnlyGet (ReadOnly), ghCommand (Seam
// behind screenedGH) and screenedGH (Screened) — nothing else.

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"os/exec"

	"github.com/Rivil/dross/internal/secretscan"
)

// (a) POST with no screen, and no registry entry: undeclared.
func leakyPost(endpoint string, body any) error {
	buf := new(bytes.Buffer)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(buf).Encode(body)
	req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", endpoint, buf)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	client := &http.Client{}
	_, err = client.Do(req)
	return err
}

// (b) registered Screened, but the screen runs AFTER the request is built.
func lateScreen(endpoint string, body any) error {
	buf := new(bytes.Buffer)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(buf).Encode(body)
	req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", endpoint, buf)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := secretscan.ScanPayload("POST "+endpoint, body); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	client := &http.Client{}
	_, err = client.Do(req)
	return err
}

// (c) clean: screened before the request, registered Screened.
func cleanPost(endpoint string, body any) error {
	if err := secretscan.ScanPayload("POST "+endpoint, body); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	buf := new(bytes.Buffer)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(buf).Encode(body)
	req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", endpoint, buf)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	client := &http.Client{}
	_, err = client.Do(req)
	return err
}

// The seam and its one screened caller, mirroring open.go.
var ghCommand = func(args ...string) *exec.Cmd { return exec.Command("gh", args...) }

func screenedGH(args ...string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
	if err := secretscan.ScanArgv("gh", args); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return ghCommand(args...), nil
}

// (d) a second caller of the seam identifier, outside screenedGH.
func leakyGH(title string) *exec.Cmd {
	return ghCommand("pr", "create", "--title", title)
}

// (e) GET with a nil body, registered ReadOnly: passes.
func readOnlyGet(endpoint string) ([]byte, error) {
	req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	client := &http.Client{}
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	return nil, nil
}

// (f) a package var bound to a func literal that reaches exec.Command, with
// no Seam entry: undeclared, and attributed to the var's name, not lost.
var rawGH = func(args ...string) *exec.Cmd { return exec.Command("gh", args...) }
